subject: ed3c/noodles#151
receipt:
Closed as DECOMPOSED, act not adopted. Trade-off record for future readers:

WHAT ACT WOULD BUY (its only increment over the surviving atoms): emulation of the workflow YAML layer itself - checkout choreography, env plumbing, step wiring. The test-oracle substance of verify.yml ('main-tip tests judge candidate as data') needs no act to reproduce locally; that is #155's whole contract.

WHAT IT COSTS: (1) custody - a new pinned dependency plus a Docker daemon requirement on the host plus runner-image drift maintenance; (2) false confidence - act is least faithful exactly at the trust-critical parts (pull_request_target semantics, GITHUB_TOKEN permission surface, credentialed dual checkout, runner image), so its green is a SANDBOX arrival that does not imply PROD behavior - worse than no signal when treated as one; (3) duplication - its high-value failure classes are already owned.

THE COMPONENT GATE (both questions negative, per the entropy law in AGENTS.md): Does act make an invalid state impossible? No - it is another representation, not an enforcement layer. Can strengthening the nearest existing contract close the same failures? Yes - #155 covers every red observed on 2026-08-30 (two transition deadlocks, one content failure).

PAYLOAD CUSTODY after decomposition: environment preflight -> #154; local trusted-preview (main-tests-vs-candidate oracle, the shift-left lever) -> #155; Actions meter and per-run cost -> #183; workflow-file defect class further shrunk by the digest pin planned in #182.

FALSIFIABLE REOPEN CONDITION: two physical instances of workflow-layer defects escaping #155's local oracle and reaching Actions. Until that evidence exists, adopting act is overdesign.
